features.name: Psycho Spins

review:
A 4x4 club cluster game where three or more touching symbols win and disappear. Crossed Symbols give transformed symbols a second value, and the xKnob turns wild and adds at least +1 to a global multiplier that sticks during Psycho Spins.

The Break symbol shakes things up. High volatility with a 25,420x max and a high 39.5% hit rate, so small wins come often while the multiplier builds. The pace fits the club setting.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
